summary: Full manual review of the pinned completion finds two major reproducibility omissions and one minor diagnostic omission. Focused tests passed (13 unit; 25 smoke/baseline with one optional skip), repository replay passed 426/426, and independent numerical/provenance checks passed 290/290. Matched metrics, historical baselines, H0 final mappings and all saved bootstrap deltas agree. Missing raw inputs for 239 OOF fits and all retained final models prevent full calibration/model evidence acceptance. The permitted ancillary recipe-selection leakage is disclosed and is not itself a defect.
